Selling a collection

Inherited tubes? Start with photographs.

You do not need to identify, sort or test everything first. Clear photographs and a brief description are usually enough to begin an honest conversation.

1

Send Photos

Show the overall collection, boxes, labels and any equipment or paperwork.

2

Initial Review

We identify likely value, useful categories and the best next step.

3

Fair Offer

Receive a straightforward offer based on condition, demand and resale work.

4

Pickup or Shipping

Local and regional pickup may be available; smaller collections can be shipped.

Professional testing equipment

Different tubes require different tools.

Our equipment includes the Amplitrex AT-1000, calibrated TV-7, Hickok 539, Maxi-Preamp II and additional specialized testers. Equipment is selected according to the tube and the information needed.
